judgement.reason: Superset is one Flask web image with Celery workers on Postgres and Redis; the websocket server and node service are optional or development-only, so the outcome with changes is right.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yml defines 3 application services (superset, superset-websocket, superset-node). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The docker-compose.yml that defines these services is a development stack with live-reload dev targets and DEV_MODE, and the file states it is not supported for production, so the production Dockerfile path runs one web process plus workers.

evidence.quote: # We don't support docker compose for production environments.
